slides.title: Drones and artillery reported near Badme
Fighting has intensified
slides.body: Two diplomatic sources told Addis Standard clashes near Badme are heavier than earlier low-level fighting.

slides.title: Both sides reportedly firing
slides.body: The diplomats said Ethiopian forces used drones and Eritrean troops used heavy artillery. Neither government has commented.

slides.title: Residents leaving
slides.body: Residents described explosions at night, closed businesses and families fleeing their homes.

slides.title: Who controls the town?
slides.body: ACLED (Nov 13): neither side. A resident told Addis Standard federal troops have been there since Nov 12.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Exercise restraint.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Addis Standard via Anadolu Agency, Nov 14, 2026
